# CalmLogs

> CalmLogs is a minimalist, edge-native, open-source distributed logging platform for developers. It enables instant log streaming from any application, container, or Docker Compose network with zero code modifications.

## Overview
- **Core Value:** Pipes stdout straight into a live dashboard. No proprietary agents, no custom SDK code patches.
- **CLI Tool:** `npm start | npx calmlogs` automatically infers project from directory name and service from `package.json`.
- **Docker Compose:** Automatically parses `<service>-<instance> | <log>` prefixes, separating containers (`api`, `postgres`, `redis`) into dedicated service dashboards dynamically.
- **Edge Native:** Built on Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects (WebSocket real-time fan-out), Cloudflare R2 (compressed JSONL cold storage), and Cloudflare D1 (SQLite relational indexes).
- **Free Tier Economics:** Runs 100% free on Cloudflare's free tier (10 GB R2, 100k Worker requests/day, 5 GB D1 database).
- **License:** MIT Open Source.
- **Website:** https://calmlogs.com
- **Documentation:** https://docs.calmlogs.com
- **Author:** Sai Akash Neela (https://saiakashneela.com / https://saiakash.dev)
- **Design Partner:** https://geeksdesigns.com

## Quickstart

### 1. Unix Pipe (Zero Configuration)
```bash
# Node.js
npm start | npx calmlogs

# Explicit Project & Service
node server.js | npx calmlogs --project "my-backend" --service "api"

# Python (unbuffered)
python -u main.py | npx calmlogs --project "ml-service" --service "worker"

# Go / Rust
go run . | npx calmlogs --project "infra" --service "gateway"
```

### 2. Process Runner
```bash
npx calmlogs run --project "core" --service "api" -- npm run dev
```

### 3. Docker Compose Sidecar Service
Add this service to your `docker-compose.yml`:
```yaml
services:
  calmlogs:
    image: node:alpine
    container_name: calmlogs-forwarder
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    # networks: [backend_net]  # Optional: limit to specific network
    command: >
      sh -c "apk add --no-cache docker-cli docker-cli-compose &&
      docker compose logs -f --no-color | npx -y calmlogs --project 'prod-stack' --key 'cl_live_...'"
```

## CLI Reference (`calmlogs`)
- `--project, -p <name>`: Project identifier. Defaults to current directory or `default`.
- `--service, -s <name>`: Service identifier. Defaults to `package.json` `name` or `app`.
- `--key, -k <token>`: Ingestion API secret key (`cl_live_...`).
- `--endpoint, -e <url>`: CalmLogs host URL (default: `http://localhost:3000`).
- `--network, -n <net>`: Optional network filter tag.

## Ingestion HTTP API
- **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/logs`
- **Headers:** `Content-Type: application/json`, `Authorization: Bearer <cl_live_key>`
- **Payload:** Single LogEvent or JSON array (maximum 1,000 logs per batch, 5MB body limit).
```json
[
  {
    "project": "core",
    "service": "api",
    "level": "info",
    "message": "User checkout completed",
    "metadata": { "orderId": "ord_123", "amount": 49.99 }
  }
]
```
